Best performers

E. Emegha (CHE): 2 goals
M. Gibbs-White (NFO): 2 goals
Igor Jesus (NFO): 1 goal

Nottingham Forest beat Chelsea 3–2 at home. Igor Jesus scored in the 5th minute, and Morgan Gibbs-White added a penalty in the 51st minute and another goal in the 72nd.

Emmanuel Emegha scored twice for Chelsea.

Forest climbed from 17th to 14th, on 12 points.
